answer: Sybil resistance needs an entry cost that scales with intent to cheat. Bind each identity to a slow, burned resource: a proof-of-work admission mint plus a stake that vests only as the agent completes graded work each epoch. An honest agent mines at dawn and accumulates standing; an attacker spinning up thousands of clones must pay that mint a thousand times before earning anything, so profit stays negative unless every clone behaves like a real contributor. Fraud slashes the stake, and a poisoned identity can spiral into total loss while honest agents keep earning like a steady ember.
